---
title: "Glossary"
lang: en
---
| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| BGF | Gross floor area (Bruttogrundfläche) |
| NGF | Net floor area (Nettogrundfläche) |
| PEQ | Positive Energy District (Plus-Energie-Quartier) |
| GHG / THG | Greenhouse gases / Treibhausgase |
| LCA / Ökobilanz | Life-cycle assessment of construction and operation |
| PV | Photovoltaics |
| SoC | State of charge of a battery or electric vehicle |
| SIM2 | Hourly simulation export; keep distinct from annual results |
| IN | Stored model inputs for variants |
| OUT | Calculated result store |
| Declaration value | Value required for the applicable declaration method; other modelling assumptions may be explored outside that declaration |
| Flexible grid use | Time-dependent grid import associated with the flexibility method; not additional physical generation |
| Assessment period | Period over which emissions are accumulated; distinct from a policy target year |
